025d555ad7c23c4e.speaker: ryan

12c520f4e16b97ea.speaker: ryan
12c520f4e16b97ea.spoken: Units first: centimetres, on a ten centimetre grid.
12c520f4e16b97ea.text: Units first: centimetres, on a ten centimetre grid.

13eac076970d75b8.speaker: ryan

13eac076970d75b8.text: Add Hole: click two metres up one helper, then the base of the other.

15e58c8ef5547eba.speaker: ryan

1793260688534a38.speaker: ryan
1793260688534a38.spoken: Select the table top, then choose Apply Material.
1793260688534a38.text: Select the table top, then choose Apply Material.

17c914ef7cf80437.speaker: ryan
17c914ef7cf80437.spoken: Set the blade height and density here, then Save.
17c914ef7cf80437.text: Set the blade height and density here, then Save.

2068f09ea7605e48.speaker: ryan
2068f09ea7605e48.spoken: Awesome. Move Copy it: pick its corner, then a grid point further along.
2068f09ea7605e48.text: Awesome. Move Copy it: pick its corner, then a grid point further along.

2303d9ca103de5f1.speaker: ryan
2303d9ca103de5f1.spoken: Press Enter to finish the chain.

2578473d2c56a8c4.speaker: ryan
2578473d2c56a8c4.spoken: Change that one column's definition later, and all twelve update together.
2578473d2c56a8c4.text: Change that one column's definition later, and all twelve update together.

25fd2f82c1c93303.speaker: ryan
25fd2f82c1c93303.spoken: Unit size says how long one model unit is. One unit, one centimetre.
25fd2f82c1c93303.text: Unit size says how long one model unit is. One unit, one centimetre.

2cb8cd1e08c87a3c.speaker: ryan

2d48e29474480892.speaker: ryan

305b7b385e2ca303.speaker: ryan
305b7b385e2ca303.spoken: Press T on the edge for a helper, then push pull three metres up it.
305b7b385e2ca303.text: Press T on the edge for a helper, then Push/Pull three metres up it.

30f728abfc8dcc5e.speaker: ryan
30f728abfc8dcc5e.spoken: Niiiice! Clear Guides removes the helper once it has done its job.
30f728abfc8dcc5e.text: Niiiice! Clear Guides removes the helper once it has done its job.

32e1237028c01f65.speaker: ryan
32e1237028c01f65.spoken: Holes are only openings. Doors and windows are separate objects.

331b8becfc3f8d9e.speaker: ryan
331b8becfc3f8d9e.spoken: Units first: centimetres, on a twenty centimetre grid.
331b8becfc3f8d9e.text: Units first: centimetres, on a twenty centimetre grid.

3b6a216fc577dffe.speaker: ryan
3b6a216fc577dffe.spoken: Parameters sit in the Object Instance panel. Set this one to 5 shelves.
3b6a216fc577dffe.text: Parameters sit in the Object Instance panel. Set this one to 5 shelves.

3dddd1a44f1fcf79.speaker: ryan
3dddd1a44f1fcf79.spoken: Same again: a helper on its edge, push pull up one grid step.
3dddd1a44f1fcf79.text: Same again: a helper on its edge, Push/Pull up one grid step.

4095b296edf00b08.speaker: ryan

40bedf7f421fdd6a.speaker: ryan

46e30fc3540f135a.speaker: ryan

4fd60be7ad38ed57.speaker: ryan

4fd60be7ad38ed57.text: Move Copy repeats it. Pick the leg's corner, then a grid point 55 cm along.

50b544a4321b5aee.speaker: ryan

52da0cc0ddd42642.speaker: ryan
52da0cc0ddd42642.spoken: Make the copy shorter, with a helper again. The first one stays as it was.

5425951febbfe55b.speaker: ryan
5425951febbfe55b.spoken: Units first: metres, on a quarter metre grid.

54616ab678a592ef.speaker: ryan

57323a25eeebd63b.speaker: ryan

5e02adcf424194b0.speaker: ryan

5e02adcf424194b0.text: Pick the centre of the circle, on the grid, then the edge of the column.

5ea19bec730f7ba0.speaker: ryan

64fec0f278947779.speaker: ryan

651f37a485d00cac.speaker: ryan
651f37a485d00cac.spoken: Rotate Copy spins copies around a centre. Select the column first.
